description.value: Donair Town is a family-run Middle Eastern restaurant chain that has served the Greater Vancouver area since 1993, built around its signature donairs in chicken, beef, lamb, and mix varieties. With multiple Lower Mainland locations, it offers a quick, protein-rich stop for cyclists needing a filling meal. The menu also covers plates, poutine, and vegetarian-friendly appetizers.
